row.title: MARKERS-ON-MAIN-1: committed conflict markers on main made every PR conflict forever
row.body: README.md and platform/adapters/README.md sat on main with both sides of a conflict (since #832). Every PR touching claim lines conflicted there and the resolver could not match a hunk inside a hunk, so PRs waited on a session. resolve_generated.py now resolves hunks innermost first, heals committed markers, and tests/foundation/test_conflict_markers.py fails the build on any marker.
